capabilities: transcribe meetings live from microphone and system audio
dictate personal notes without a recording
clean up or enhance notes and saved transcripts with AI
configure AI backends including Claude, Codex, Cursor, ACP, and Ollama
save linked transcript notes alongside the meeting note
disambiguation: Not a text-expansion or abbreviation tool; despite the name it converts live speech and meeting audio into notes via AI.
extras: Desktop only and requires the separate free Shorthand desktop app (0.5.0+); transcription is local, and recordings and transcripts are deleted by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in speech transcription, so capturing spoken meetings or dictated thoughts into structured notes requires external tools and manual cleanup.

relations.evidence: Claude Code may also search other notes in your vault when you choose that backend.
use a local model with Ollama.

summary: AI dictation and meeting-notes plugin that transcribes speech locally and turns meetings or dictated thoughts into organized Obsidian notes.
